### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>shirou/gopsutil (github.com/shirou/gopsutil/v4)</summary>

### [`v4.26.9`](https://redirect.github.com/shirou/gopsutil/releases/tag/v4.26.9)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/shirou/gopsutil/compare/v4.26.8...v4.26.9)

<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v4.26.9 -->

##### What's Changed

##### cpu

- \[cpu]\[linux]: expose raw tick counters through ExLinux by [@​fzlzjerry](https://redirect.github.com/fzlzjerry) in [#​2149](https://redirect.github.com/shirou/gopsutil/pull/2149)
- \[cpu]\[darwin]: don't crash in getFrequency when pmgr lacks voltage-states5-sram by [@​hsdfat](https://redirect.github.com/hsdfat) in [#​2163](https://redirect.github.com/shirou/gopsutil/pull/2163)

##### docker

- \[docker]\[linux]: support cgroup v2 in Cgroup\* functions by [@​hsdfat](https://redirect.github.com/hsdfat) in [#​2143](https://redirect.github.com/shirou/gopsutil/pull/2143)
- \[docker]\[linux]: fix the "all cgroup" case on cgroup v1 by [@​shirou](https://redirect.github.com/shirou) in [#​2154](https://redirect.github.com/shirou/gopsutil/pull/2154)

##### host

- \[linux] host: add nixos by [@​stepbrobd](https://redirect.github.com/stepbrobd) in [#​2144](https://redirect.github.com/shirou/gopsutil/pull/2144)

##### mem

- \[mem]\[linux]: document that Cached includes SReclaimable by [@​shirou](https://redirect.github.com/shirou) in [#​2155](https://redirect.github.com/shirou/gopsutil/pull/2155)

##### net

- net: fix MIB\_IF\_ROW2 layout on Windows 386 by [@​zhangli091011](https://redirect.github.com/zhangli091011) in [#​2120](https://redirect.github.com/shirou/gopsutil/pull/2120)
- fix(net): include FIFO errors in aggregate I/O counters by [@​jakezwang](https://redirect.github.com/jakezwang) in [#​2153](https://redirect.github.com/shirou/gopsutil/pull/2153)
- \[net]\[linux]: skip ESRCH from /proc/<pid>/fd in getProcInodesAll by [@​KobayashiKosuke](https://redirect.github.com/KobayashiKosuke) in [#​2161](https://redirect.github.com/shirou/gopsutil/pull/2161)

##### process

- \[ci]\[windows]: run the test suite on windows/386 by [@​shirou](https://redirect.github.com/shirou) in [#​2151](https://redirect.github.com/shirou/gopsutil/pull/2151)
- feat(darwin): implement EnvironWithContext for Darwin processes by [@​nako-ruru](https://redirect.github.com/nako-ruru) in [#​2135](https://redirect.github.com/shirou/gopsutil/pull/2135)
- Return an error on empty OpenBSD KinfoProc by [@​AshSgDe29071999](https://redirect.github.com/AshSgDe29071999) in [#​2142](https://redirect.github.com/shirou/gopsutil/pull/2142)

##### Other Changes

- Bump perfstat to fix memory leaks by [@​pgimalac](https://redirect.github.com/pgimalac) in [#​2148](https://redirect.github.com/shirou/gopsutil/pull/2148)
- \[common]: use reflect.Pointer instead of the deprecated reflect.Ptr by [@​shirou](https://redirect.github.com/shirou) in [#​2156](https://redirect.github.com/shirou/gopsutil/pull/2156)

##### New Contributors

- [@​nako-ruru](https://redirect.github.com/nako-ruru) made their first contribution in [#​2135](https://redirect.github.com/shirou/gopsutil/pull/2135)
- [@​AshSgDe29071999](https://redirect.github.com/AshSgDe29071999) made their first contribution in [#​2142](https://redirect.github.com/shirou/gopsutil/pull/2142)
- [@​stepbrobd](https://redirect.github.com/stepbrobd) made their first contribution in [#​2144](https://redirect.github.com/shirou/gopsutil/pull/2144)
- [@​zhangli091011](https://redirect.github.com/zhangli091011) made their first contribution in [#​2120](https://redirect.github.com/shirou/gopsutil/pull/2120)
